description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named ProductReviewController. It manages administrative actions related to product reviews, including displaying review pages, paginating reviews via AJAX, and removing reviews. It interacts with services for products and reviews, and handles authorization with role-based security annotations.

classes.name: ProductReviewController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller class for managing product reviews in admin interface.

methods.name: displayProductReviews
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product review page for a specific product.

methods.name: pageProductReviews
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX requests to fetch paginated reviews for a product.

methods.name: deleteProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX requests to remove a specific product review.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu context for the view.
